summary_1line: Yudhishthira questions Bhishma and Vrihaspati about righteousness, rebirth, and karma, leading to teachings that only Dharma follows a soul after death and determines future births.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies upon his bed of arrows while Yudhishthira approaches with folded hands to ask about the path to happiness and righteousness.
The sage Vrihaspati descends from the sky before the gathered kings and elders, who rise to honor the celestial preceptor.
A solitary soul leaves its corpse while relatives turn away, and only the radiant figure of Dharma follows it on the path to the next world.
